newsitem.title: ITALY: Rome airports passenger traffic up 8.8 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Rome airports passenger traffic up 8.8 pct in Jan.

text.p: Rome airport operator Aeroporti di Roma said on Friday passenger traffic at the Italian capital's two airports rose 8.8 percent to 1.77 million in January.
Rome's main Fiumicino airport had an average daily passenger traffic of 55,536 and the number of air travellers rose 8.5 percent in the month to 1.72 million, ADR said in a statement.
Average daily passenger traffic was 1,467 at Ciampino airport, bringing the total to 45,464 in the month, a rise of 21.8 percent, ADR said.
The number of take-offs and landings rose 12.1 percent at Fiumicino in January and 7.4 percent at Ciampino.
ADR, which is controlled by Italian state holding IRI, is due to be privatised fully by the end of 1998. An initial flotation is planned early this year.

The ADR statement said the company had 1996 turnover of more than one trillion lire ($602 billion), but gave no more details. Group net profits rose 63.7 percent to 56.08 billion lire in calendar 1995 on turnover of 978.05 billion.
